title: Reindexing internal Hom on actual derived coefficient systems and its reduction square
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and $B_{W,n}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)_W$, $R_W=\lim_n B_{W,n}$ for a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ be a scheme isomorphism, with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $F=g^{-1}$, with the coefficient identifications induced by all quotient projections. Use the coefficient-stage derived operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

Let $\mathscr S_W$ be the abelian category of strict systems of $B_{W,n}$-module sheaves with coefficient-linear quotient transitions, and let $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$, $\mathcal I_W$ and $\beta_W$ be the actual derived-system operations and comparisons of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Reindexing is an exact equivalence $\mathscr S_Y\simeq\mathscr S_X$ keeping the inverse-sequence index and every coefficient arrow unchanged. It preserves K-injectivity and K-flatness in these abelian system categories, induces an equivalence of their ordinary unbounded derived categories, and has an actual natural isomorphism of system internal Homs
$$F_\bullet R\mathcal Hom_{B_{Y,\bullet}}(A,B)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_{B_{X,\bullet}}(F_\bullet A,F_\bullet B).$$
Its product-Hom representative and evaluation are reindexings of the simultaneous system complexes. For cartesian first input its derived evaluations equal the finite-level $c^0$ comparisons and preserve the specified evaluation and transposition. For $m\geq n$, writing $S=-\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n$ and $H_m=R\mathcal Hom_{B_m}(A_m,B_m^{\rm input})$, its reduction transition is the transpose of
$$S(H_m)\otimes^L A_n\xrightarrow{1\otimes(t^A_{m,n})^{-1}}S(H_m)\otimes^L S(A_m)\cong S(H_m\otimes^L A_m)\xrightarrow{S(\mathrm{ev})}S(B_m^{\rm input})\xrightarrow{t^B_{m,n}}B_n^{\rm input}.$$
Reindexing commutes with this entire word, including scalar extension, inverse first-input transition, and the second-input transition.

For arbitrary ambient $R_Y$-complexes $M,N$, the square whose top is $\mathcal R_X(FH_Y(M,N))\to\mathcal R_XH_X(FM,FN)$, whose bottom is $F_\bullet\mathcal I_Y(\mathcal R_YM,\mathcal R_YN)\to\mathcal I_X(\mathcal R_XFM,\mathcal R_XFN)$, and whose vertical maps are the specified $\beta$ and reduction/reindexing identifications, commutes in the derived system category. The system evaluation, transposition and reduction/limit unit and counit squares commute there; applying the functorial $\mathcal L_X$ gives the corresponding realized identities. These are actual system identities prior to limit realization; neither equality detection by level evaluations nor invertibility of $\beta$ for arbitrary inputs is asserted.
